title: Hexagon Motif Blanket
description: A cosy baby blanket made from simple hexagon motifs joined as you go.
materials: Soft worsted or DK yarn (3-4 colours)
expectationText: A rewarding larger project built from repeatable motifs. Each hexagon works up quickly, and joining as you go means minimal finishing at the end.

steps.title: Plan your colours
steps.instruction: Choose 3 or 4 colours. You will need roughly 30 hexagons for a baby-sized blanket about 90 by 75 cm.

steps.title: Make a hexagon
steps.instruction: Magic ring. Round 1: chain 3, 2 dc, ch 1, then (3 dc, ch 1) five times, join with slip stitch. Round 2: chain 3, 2 dc in same space, ch 1, (3 dc in next ch-space, ch 1) around, join.

steps.title: Join as you go
steps.instruction: After making the first hexagon, join each subsequent hexagon to its neighbour by replacing the centre chain of Round 2 with a slip stitch into the adjacent hexagon.

steps.title: Arrange in rows
steps.instruction: Lay out 5 hexagons per row alternating point-up and point-flat. Fill half-hexagons along the edges for straight sides.

steps.title: Add a border
steps.instruction: Single crochet around the entire blanket edge in your favourite colour to create a clean frame.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in all ends. Block lightly with steam for a flat, drapey finish.
